summary: Danganronpa entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Danganronpa: Trigger Happy Havoc
entries.definitive_edition: Steam PC release for main play, with Anniversary Edition documented for gallery/extras if desired

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC release for capture; Anniversary Edition for extras comparison

primary.version: Current Steam PC release, with Anniversary Edition noted separately
primary.why: The PC release is the best capture route for the first Danganronpa. Anniversary Edition routes add gallery/quality-of-life extras on mobile/Switch/Xbox, so those should be documented when the archive wants the modern extras.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam PC release. Record build, resolution, input, language, chapter/trial completion, School Mode, gallery state, spoiler settings, and whether Anniversary Edition on Switch/mobile/Xbox was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting original Japanese/handheld behavior.
secondary.why: PC is the better capture route.

secondary.platform: Anniversary Edition on mobile / Switch / Xbox
secondary.why: It is a different modern edition path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Avoid spoiler leakage in notes; record edition and gallery state.
